features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: At 2nd level, learn acid splash. Circle spells at L3/5/7/9: enlarge/reduce + spider climb, iron gut + meld into stone, blight + freedom of movement, contagion + seeming. Always prepared.

features.name: Ooze Form
features.description:
At 2nd level, expend one Wild Shape as bonus action to become ooze-like for 10 min (1 hour at L10). Retain game stats.
- **Acid Weapons:** +1d6 acid on melee hits (2d6 at L10)
- **Amorphous:** Move through 1-inch spaces
- **Climber:** 20 ft climb speed
- **Oozing Form:** Reaction when touched/hit within 5 ft: 1d6 acid (2d6 at L10)

features.name: Slimy Pseudopod
features.description: At 6th level, bonus action to grow pseudopod for 1 min. Make melee spell attack as bonus action each turn: 1d6 acid (2d6 at L10). Prof bonus uses/long rest.

features.name: Improved Ooze Form
features.description: At 10th level, ooze form lasts 1 hour. Acid damage from Acid Weapons and Oozing Form increases to 2d6.

features.name: Engulfing Embrace
features.description: At 14th level, while in ooze form, action to engulf a same-size-or-smaller creature within 5 ft. DEX save or engulfed: restrained, total cover from outside, 2d6 acid initially + 4d6 acid at start of your turns. Escape: STR (Athletics) vs spell save DC. 1/long rest (or 5th+ slot).
